opening.argument: The presentation is structured as instruction and operational demonstration, centered on building an automated trading algorithm rather than promising a guaranteed payout. The speaker discusses “how to think about or how I think about building a custom trading algorithm,” including exchange flow and risk management around the Kelly Criterion, and says live demonstrations will accompany the discussion. Its performance example is expressly qualified: “It returned, you know, 43% over a two week period,” but exchange and trading fees would have made the result “much lower than this.” The speaker also rejects the underlying sales model, stating, “I don't sell bots. I don't believe in selling bots,” and advises viewers considering bots sold online that they are “wasting your money.” Course coupons and attendee rewards therefore remain promotional or engagement-related, without a shown deceptive mechanism.
